results.title: Lo que en nosotros calla
results.overview: Carmen Castillo is internationally known for her literary and film work, in which her Chilean roots and the political and human tragedies of her native country play a central role. In this film, she breaks the silence she has maintained for 50 years around her own history and that of her children. She looks back on events that began in 1970s Chile, when her 'compañero' Miguel Enríquez—like her, a member of the left-wing guerrilla organization MIR—was killed and she herself was abducted and imprisoned by the new dictatorship.

results.title: Out of Orbit
results.overview: When everything changes overnight, a young couple must decide what comes next.

results.title: The Trial That Never Happened
results.overview: Ana Clara Gomes Machado was five years old and used to say she wanted to be just like her mother when she grew up. On the morning of February 2, 2021, while playing outside her home, she was struck by four rifle rounds fired by a military police officer in Rio de Janeiro.  The Civil Police detective who arrived at the scene of the killing stated there was no doubt as to who fired the shots: Corporal Bruno Delaroli. The case remained without a trial for five years. Just as the family believed justice was within reach, a new lawyer joined the case, and to this day, the officer has yet to stand trial. That lawyer was, at the time, a sitting senator—now a candidate for the Presidency of the Republic—Flávio Bolsonaro.  What was a senator’s motive for defending a man caught in the act of murdering a child? To this day, her mother, Cristiane Gomes da Silva, mourns the loss of her daughter and the justice that never arrived.

results.title: Men of Law
results.overview: A retired detective and his cousin launch a rescue operation when the detective's daughter is kidnapped by a trafficking ring, and law enforcement isn't doing their job.

results.title: Stop Being So Dramatic
results.overview: Haunted by a painful past, Julia escapes into a dark fairy-tale world where mocking witches force her to confront the emotional weight she has carried for years.

results.title: Where did our river flow to?
results.overview: When does a river start dying? Who will remember the river once it disappears? Blending observation, oral histories, and personal narration, the film moves between memory and the present, revealing how ecological change quietly alters landscapes, livelihoods, and cultural traditions as the community learns to live with its absence.

results.title: B.A.E. - Before Anything Else
results.overview: On the threshold of adulthood, Romeo spends a final summer in Tropea with his friends, where he meets Giulia, a local theater enthusiast. As their romance blossoms, the two end up starring in a local production of Romeo and Juliet, and their real lives begin to painfully parallel the classic play. Facing opposition from Giulia’s overprotective brother and the pressure of an uncertain future, their bond deepens until a tragic confrontation alters their lives forever. B.A.E. - Before Anything Else is a poignant exploration of first love, passion, and devastating sacrifice.

results.title: Nevrine
results.overview: Akshay, a young man, loses the girl he loved dearly. He recalls the moments he spent with her.

results.title: Remembranza
results.overview: Remembranza is a work that employs photogrammetry and the archive as mechanisms for reconstruction and memory. Through 3D scanning, the Votive Temple of Maipú is transformed into an object—a vessel for memories. It is an exercise that uses the errors of an imperfect scan to demonstrate the fragility of memory.

results.title: End Tina
results.overview: A friendship comes to a violent end.

results.title: It's Only Sex
results.overview: Sébastien gets involved with young people living with HIV, like himself, to help them reclaim a shame-free sex life. While he is forced to face his own difficulty in breaking out of his sexual abstinence, a date with Avril pushes him to his limits.
